concept.title: Reusable help content
concept.shortdesc: Paragraphs and notes that several help topics share. Not published on its own.

conbody.note: Starting a run and approving or rejecting a rule need you to sign in with a Google account that the deployment allows. Everyone else can read every run, report and rule.
One run at a time keeps the deployment inside the Google Cloud free tier. A migrate run takes about two minutes; a run with the agent takes about six.
conbody.p: The checks decide whether a topic passes. The agent can propose a fix, but it can't change a check result, and a writer approves every rule before it is used again.
